create_video_lmdb_database: create an lmdb database of videos from a list file with video paths and labels for Caffe2 VideoInputOp
run_create_video_lmdb_cli: run the create_video_lmdb module via argparse CLI with --dataset_dir and --list_file arguments
build_video_lmdb_storing_paths: build a video lmdb database that stores local file paths instead of raw video data
build_video_lmdb_storing_raw_data: build a video lmdb database that stores raw video bytes directly in the database
create_video_lmdb_with_labels: create a video lmdb database with comma-separated integer labels for each video clip
